# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform alignment and rendering reliability**

## Highlights

The upcoming release improves rendering reliability and updates Apple and Uno platform requirements. Android texture rendering follows display refresh, native callbacks use the correct boolean widths, and bundled HarfBuzz avoids Linux symbol conflicts. Apple deployment minimums rise, while the Uno views move to Uno Platform 7 and .NET 10.

## Breaking Changes

- **Raise Apple application deployment targets** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp native libraries now require macOS 12 and iOS, tvOS, and Mac Catalyst 15. Raise application deployment targets accordingly, preserving any higher framework requirement. The final minimums supersede the earlier macOS 11 and iOS/tvOS/Catalyst 14 native baseline. Xcode 27 source builds are supported; .NET 9 targets remain available. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383), [#5514](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5514))
- **Move Uno integrations to Uno Platform 7** — SkiaSharp.Views.Uno.WinUI uses Uno Platform 7, with .NET 10 required for its non-Windows assembly. Upgrade Uno applications and use the .NET SDK WebAssembly native-asset path: the old per-platform runtime packages and pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipeline are no longer supported. Windows target frameworks remain facades over SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering on Uno** — On non-Windows Uno targets, SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid and renders through a CPU-backed SKXamlCanvas. GRContext is null and the PaintSurface backend target has a zero framebuffer. Use SKCanvasElement when GPU rendering is required, and remove uses of the dropped RaiseOnUnsupported member. DrawInBackground remains unsupported; the WinAppSDK control remains ANGLE-backed. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Rebuild custom WebAssembly archives for WebGPU** — The WebGPU C++ support is now compiled into libSkiaSharp.a rather than on the application's final link line, avoiding C++ flags being applied to application C sources. Newer consumers need rebuilt archives containing that support; pre-change archives and GPU-disabled custom archives do not satisfy the link contract. JavaScript glue remains a consumer-side link input, and the .NET 8 built-in WebGPU path is retained. ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Engine

- **Skia m156 shader and upload fixes** — Rejects overflowing Raster Pipeline slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types during parsing. Ganesh GL also stops using a BGRA8-as-RGBx upload configuration that is invalid in GLES; readback is unchanged. These are same-milestone fixes with no managed API changes. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))

## Bug Fixes

- **Display-paced Android texture rendering** — Automatic continuous GLTextureView rendering, including MAUI Android SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, follows display callbacks instead of buffer-swap throughput. Drawing stays on the GL worker; explicit render requests remain independent rather than being capped to the display rate. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Correct native callback boolean widths** — Skia callbacks use one-byte boolean values and HarfBuzz callbacks use four-byte integers, correcting native ABI mismatches including Apple ARM64 interpreter returns. Public managed APIs and delegates still use bool. False-returning HarfBuzz glyph-name callbacks no longer copy the name buffer. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **Unicode character-code validation corrected** — StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode validates one encoded unit: ASCII for UTF-8, one UTF-16 unit, or one UTF-32 code point. It correctly handles valid inputs and rejects empty, multi-unit, and unsupported-encoding inputs. GetString now throws ArgumentNullException rather than NullReferenceException for null byte arrays. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))
- **Linux HarfBuzz load-order conflicts avoided** — Internal calls stay within bundled HarfBuzz instead of being redirected to a system copy loaded by GTK or another library, preventing incompatible private objects from being mixed. The common Linux recipe, including nodeps and clang-cross variants, retains exported entry points and managed signatures. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Native C-string copying corrected** — Fixes a native buffer over-read in FromCString and writes directly to SKData. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Fewer temporary allocations** — Valid managed image pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation while preserving native validation for invalid inputs. HarfBuzzSharp pools the AddUtf32 string encoding buffer and avoids native feature-string allocation without changing decoding behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **Front-buffered stream retention fixed** — Fixes a retention issue in front-buffered streams. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Platform

- **Updated Windows integration dependencies** — Windows library dependencies align with MAUI 9 and 10 using Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003. Bundled WinUI ANGLE advances from chromium/6275 to chromium/8118, with matching PDB names for packaged DLLs. These updates do not change the declared Windows runtime minimums. ([#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390), [#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321))
